scope: Disposable Kind v1.36.1 fixture. Preserves the published kubectl Secret diff observations, then runs one bounded Kubernetes Job twice with public synthetic input: once with output filtering disabled and once with a structured field redaction policy. It treats the sample as untrusted output data and validates the fixture flag against a closed set. The Job writes separate artifact, checkpoint, and pipeline metadata JSON records to a PVC and prints a training-log JSON record. Output values are inspected only in memory and are never written to lab evidence or command logs. An independent read-only Pod observes records after the Jobs complete. An invalid policy Job stops before creating sinks. A scoped read-only Secret mount supplies the inert input to one Job while the unmounted comparison emits no outputs. A pinned scanner and digest-gated promotion cover files and OCI archives. Real deployment formats and authorities require separate evidence.
